client_brief:
A visually led creator-ad cut and three matching hook-card canvases

Halden Greens needs a short creator-ad package built from nine supplied clips. The current tub and the previous packaging must not be mixed up. Please select for visual continuity and check the crop safety in the platform version.

$2,500-$6,500 fixed; 2 to 4 weeks. Review structure: One direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

The three deliverables are:

A visually led highlight no longer than 15 seconds assembled only from the 9 supplied short clips, plus one platform reframe. Any automated highlight selection is a visual aid, not evidence that speech or claims have been understood. Inspect the returned edit for subject continuity, crop safety, and repeated shots before delivery.

One thumbnail for the platform slot, built at source scale with no enlargement and with the shortfall named if the stated size cannot be reached honestly, plus the usable creator photographs brought to one restrained target that sits beside the footage rather than above it, with the previous tub frames identified and excluded. Per frame parameter log.

Halden hook cards, three canvases, as one editable document plus its source: Choose and adapt an Adobe Express template for these supporting pieces, using the supplied brand, approved copy and imagery. Select the strongest fit, replace the template content and correct its background as needed. Supply the editable design link and the requested export, in addition to the commissioned custom production work.

Keep the still treatment restrained enough to sit beside the footage. A glossy thumbnail that feels like a different shoot is not the aim. If the platform size exceeds the usable source, identify that shortfall instead of enlarging the image and treating it as resolved.

Assets: source_video_files/ (9 measured short files); motion_source_metadata.json; halden_creator_stills/ (6 phone photographs, 4032 x 3024); halden_thumb_hero.jpg (1080 x 1920); halden_wordmark.png; halden_hooks.txt; halden_tone_reference.png.

Media inventory: 9 video files, 44.378 seconds in total; 0 with embedded audio; 0 separate audio files (0 seconds). These measured sources set the production limits.

Use approved copy for the hook cards. Visual selection does not establish what a person said or substantiate a product claim.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note, Stock license and asset IDs and the final edit decision list and measured source metadata, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise. Keep runtime within measured source duration and the stated cap; do not invent footage or dialogue.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: GROUNDED in the real PeoplePerHour brief 'Video Ads for DTC Supplement Brand (UGC / VSL / Mashup)', quoted in the ledger grounding_note: a direct to consumer supplement brand supplies a batch of raw user generated talking head creator clips plus product b roll and wants them cut into short paid social ad variants testing DIFFERENT HOOKS, each reframed to the platform native ratios, with on brand text, captions and callout graphics added, and platform ready cuts plus a scroll stopping thumbnail delivered, conversion focused and fast. The posted brief names no client, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional brand Halden Greens. The real post treats the caption and hook layer as an afterthought bolted onto the cut; CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) is what lets this be built as the client actually needs it, because HTML authoring returns a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, which turns 'we will be swapping hooks every week' from a promise into a deliverable the growth lead can operate without recommissioning anyone.

real_brief_anchor: GROUNDED in the real PeoplePerHour brief 'Video Ads for DTC Supplement Brand (UGC / VSL / Mashup)', quoted in the ledger grounding_note: a direct to consumer supplement brand supplies a batch of raw user generated talking head creator clips plus product b roll and wants them cut into short paid social ad variants testing DIFFERENT HOOKS, each reframed to the platform native ratios, with on brand text, captions and callout graphics added, and platform ready cuts plus a scroll stopping thumbnail delivered, conversion focused and fast. The posted brief names no client, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional brand Halden Greens. The real post treats the caption and hook layer as an afterthought bolted onto the cut; CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) is what lets this be built as the client actually needs it, because HTML authoring returns a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, which turns 'we will be swapping hooks every week' from a promise into a deliverable the growth lead can operate without recommissioning anyone.
price_band_and_audience: Fifty nine dollars a month on subscription, buyer 25 to 40, health literate and specifically sceptical of polish. The band is load bearing in an unusual direction: the money is real but the look must be cheap, because at subscription economics the acquisition cost is decided by whether the ad survives being recognised as an ad. Grade lightly, keep the phone framing, keep the room noise short of unintelligible, set the hooks in plain type at conversational length. The same product at a hundred and forty dollars a month would correctly be shot in a studio, graded cool and clean, with restrained type and generous space, and shipping that treatment here reads as a company pretending to be a person, which is the single most expensive mistake available on this brief. Push the other way into flashing text, countdowns and stacked badges and it reads as a fifteen dollar tub, which contradicts the subscription price. A posted job of this shape runs 700 to 1,800 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: Direct to consumer daily greens powder sold online on a monthly subscription, creator seeded.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2023, Portland, Oregon, online only, a small founder led team with a growth lead and three seeded creators.
brand_identity.about: Halden Greens is a daily greens powder people actually keep drinking, sold by subscription to buyers who have already been let down by a supplement that promised too much. We grow by putting the product in real kitchens and letting real people talk, not by looking like an advert. That distrust of polish is the brand.
brand_identity.audience: Health literate adults 25 to 40 who are specifically wary of supplement marketing and trust a friend's recommendation over a glossy campaign.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Fifty nine dollars a month on subscription. Priced as a considered daily habit, above the fifteen dollar tub and below the studio shot premium brands. The money is real, so the look must never be.
brand_identity.typography: One friendly, near neutral sans set at conversational size, plain weights only. Type should look unconsidered while being entirely considered: no countdowns, no stacked badges, no burst text. Hooks read like a caption a person typed, not a headline.
brand_identity.voice: Conversational, honest to a fault, a little self aware, never hype. Example: "We are not going to tell you it changed our life. It is greens. You drink them in the morning."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark exists only as a flat export, dark disjoint letters on white, with no vector source. The brand green panel is fixed and every cutout has to hold against it. Some earlier photography still shows a previous tub label and should not be reused.
brand_identity.values: Say only what we can stand behind. Claims live inside the category compliance sheet, and anything the sheet forbids does not run, however good the line.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which visible beats in the measured short clips actually cut together without a continuity jump, duplicate action, or missing subject.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Filenames and source duration do not establish visual continuity. The first assembled proof is the earliest reliable evidence.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Replace or reorder source ranges, shorten the piece, and rebuild the EDL around the strongest continuous action.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A technically valid render feels accidental or implies an action that the source never completes.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the approved horizontal composition survives the required vertical or square reframe with the subject and essential interface or product detail still visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The crop depends on the actual chosen ranges and subject position inside each rendered frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Choose a different source range for the platform version or use fit instead of fill and revise the surrounding design treatment.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The platform export is correctly sized but loses the person, product, or interface that gives the shot meaning.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the silent final piece still communicates clearly without implying dialogue, ambience, or music that was never supplied.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: This can be judged only on the final rendered sequence, not from a successful operation response.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Strengthen visual sequencing or approved on-screen copy without fabricating a soundtrack.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The deliverable relies on absent sound and fails when viewed as supplied.

verifiers_human.text: The product stays in frame for the whole time it is on screen in every platform version, including the square one.
verifiers_human.how: Play each version and watch the tub, particularly on any version derived from a horizontal source.

verifiers_human.text: Every hook card is readable over the footage it plays on, over both the bright kitchen and the dark counter, at running size.
verifiers_human.how: Open the exported document, look at each canvas in Express, and place each card over the frame it is intended for.

verifiers_human.text: The stills sit beside the footage rather than above it, and none shows the previous tub.
verifiers_human.how: View the thumbnail and the still set next to a frame of the cut, and check every tub against the current label.

verifiers_human.text: The cut reads as something a friend sent rather than as an agency edit, and the spoken claim is intelligible throughout.
verifiers_human.how: Watch the cut and each platform version end to end with sound, at phone scale.

verifiers_human.text: The quietest creator is audible and the loudest has not become harsh.
verifiers_human.how: Listen to the cut at a low volume and then at a normal volume, comparing the creators against each other.

why_not_vlm: A generated video would replace the supplied people, products, interfaces, locations, and finite recorded actions rather than edit them. This task is scored on traceability to measured source ranges, final framing, and truthful use of separate audio, which a newly generated clip cannot satisfy.

doability_proof.status: doable with the current ChatGPT Adobe connector profile and declared exception paths
proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.
The client brief is host-neutral; connector-specific scoring is isolated in connector_profile and verifier_contract.
Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
